# Cannot compute: CN code required

The ruleset makes the CN code a **required input** and says not to estimate if it is missing. The datasheet gives no CN code, so I can't produce a single embedded-emissions figure.

## Inputs check

| Required input | Status |
|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | **Missing.** The description doesn't map to one table entry. |
| (b) Country of production | India, which is listed for every code |
| (c) Quantity | 600 t |

## Why the description isn't enough

"Semi-finished steel product, continuously cast, carbon ~0.2%" could fall under more than one heading:

- **7207 11 90**, Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel, contai… The description is cut off, so I can't confirm whether the carbon threshold or other criteria for this subheading are met.
- **7206 10 00**, Ingots, of iron and non-alloy steel… This is a primary/semi-finished form that the description doesn't clearly rule out.

Assigning the CN code is a customs classification decision. It is not something to infer here, and the choice changes the result substantially.

## What the figure would be once the code is confirmed (India, 600 t)

These are shown only to show the scale of the difference. Neither is a reportable result.

| If the CN code is… | SEE (tCO2e/t) | Calculation | Embedded emissions |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7207 11 90 | 4.32 | 4.32 × 600 | **2,592.00 tCO2e** |
| 7206 10 00 | 2.64 | 2.64 × 600 | **1,584.00 tCO2e** |

The two figures differ by about 1,008 tCO2e.

## Next step

Please give the **8-digit CN code** from the customs declaration or the supplier's commercial documents. I'll then report the single result, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
